title: Egyptian-Style Turkey Kebabs
description: Delicious and flavorful turkey kebabs infused with the spices of Egypt, perfect for a quick and easy meal. Serve with your favorite sides or as a snack on its own.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together kebab seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Cut turkey breast into 1-inch pieces and toss with kebab seasoning mixture.
Thread turkey and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush kebabs with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through and lightly charred.
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
If using neck bones, simmer in a small saucepan with 1 cup of water for 10-15 minutes, or until meat falls off the bone. Strain and serve on the side.
